prompt:
{task}

You are on the branch this change will be proposed from. Commit your work on it. This checkout cannot reach GitHub, so do not push: write the pull request you would open (its title on the first line, then its description) to PR.md at the repository root, uncommitted. `pnpm ci:local` is out of scope here; skip it and say so in PR.md.

cases.task: The sessions sidebar says "No sessions yet." under a project with no sessions. Change it to "Nothing here yet." in English, and the Spanish equivalent in Spanish.
cases.why: A copy change in packages/translations: no component file changes, but the screen does.

cases.task: On a phone (390px wide) the settings pages are broken: the settings navigation keeps its desktop width and squeezes the page beside it into a sliver, so the profile cards wrap one word per line. Make the settings layout work at phone width without changing the desktop layout.
cases.why: A real layout bug in apps/web at a width nobody looks at by default; the screenshot has to be taken at a phone width to show the fix.

cases.task: Cards across the console look too sharp. Give the design system's Card a larger corner radius (rounded-xl instead of rounded-lg).
cases.why: A design-system change: it shows only on a console route that renders a Card, which the agent has to find.

cases.task: Add a domain test for apps/api/src/api-tokens/domain/ip-allowlist.policy.ts covering an IPv6 address inside and outside an allowed range. Fix the policy if the test finds a bug.
cases.why: Decoy: API only. Nothing to photograph, so starting the console or taking screenshots is wasted time.

cases.task: apps/web/src/features/tasks/lib/board-search.ts has no direct unit test. Add one in the feature's __tests__ directory that covers how a search string is parsed.
cases.why: Decoy: an apps/web change that is only a test. The screenshot rule names tests as not visual.
